notes: The last of the four braking cases: a corner you take WITHOUT braking where your reference brakes now gets a verdict instead of showing nothing. The corner own time decides it - quicker than your reference is purple, level is green, losing time is amber or red by how much. With 0.9.158 that completes the set: reference flat and you flat is green (you matched it), reference flat and you brake is amber for a dab or red for a real stop, and both braking is compared by distance as before. Also in this build: field events are no longer logged twice when a recording was started before SMART; your desktop can no longer end up in a highlight clip, because the display-capture layer is off while GOAT re-records camera angles; SMART remembers the brake bias you actually ran, read live from the car since it is saved into no setup file; the finished video is named and opened from the Highlights panel and named by when it was made; the Stint and Corners windows show the turns that fit with the one you are approaching in the middle; the Stint and Drill panels scale their text; the radar redraws at 33 ms; iRacing qualifying no longer calls cars closing behind you; and the chequered flag waits until you cross the line instead of the leader.
